In this lab, you'll get some more experience working with annotations.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev = "png", dpi = 150, 
  out.width="75%", fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6
)

library(tidyverse)
library(socviz)
library(ggrepel)
```


# Print out 10 randomly sampled rows from the `elections_historic` dataset

```{r}
elections_historic %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```


# Recreate the plot from the lecture notes

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggplot(elections_historic,
        aes(x = popular_pct,
            y = ec_pct,
            label = winner_label)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Winner's share of Electoral College Votes",
       title = "Popular & Electoral College Margins",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.")
```

# Focus the text labels

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggplot(elections_historic,
        aes(x = popular_pct,
            y = ec_pct)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = elections_historic %>%
                    filter(year >= 1992),
                  aes(label = winner_label)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Winner's share of Electoral College Votes",
       title = "Popular & Electoral College Margins",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.")
```

# Color political parties

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggplot(elections_historic,
        aes(x = popular_pct,
            y = ec_pct,
            color = factor(win_party, levels = c("Rep.", "D.-R.", "Dem.", "Whig")))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = elections_historic %>%
                    filter(year >= 1992),
                  aes(label = winner_label)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Winner's share of Electoral College Votes",
       title = "Popular & Electoral College Margins",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.",
       color = "Party")
```

# Highlighting rectangle

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggplot(elections_historic,
        aes(x = popular_pct,
            y = ec_pct)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .5, size = 1.4, color = "gray80") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = elections_historic %>%
                    filter(year >= 1992),
                  aes(label = winner_label)) +
  annotate(geom = "rect",
           xmin = -Inf, xmax = .5,
           ymin = .5, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate(geom = "text",
            x = .32, y = .8,
            label = "Presidents who won\nwith electoral vote,\nbut did not have the\nmajority popular vote.",
            hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Winner's share of Electoral College Votes",
       title = "Popular & Electoral College Margins",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.")
```

# Make a Cleveland dot plot

```{r}
ggplot(elections_historic) +
  geom_point(aes(x = popular_pct, y = reorder(year, popular_pct))) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Year",
       title = "Popular Vote by Year",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.")
```

# Cleveland dot plot

```{r}
ggplot(elections_historic) +
  geom_point(aes(x = popular_pct,
                 y = reorder(year, popular_pct),
                 color = ifelse(popular_pct >= .5 | ec_pct <= .5, "Other", "Majority Electoral Vote but not Popular Vote"))) +
  labs(x = "Winner's share of Popular Vote",
       y = "Year",
       title = "Popular Vote by Year",
       caption = "Data for 2016 are provisional.",
       color = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
